title: Crash Twinsanity
about: The known retail dumps of the title: the whole image's sectors, size, CRC-32, MD5 and SHA-1 exactly as each redump.org disc page publishes them (Track 1; a DVD dump is the image of its 2048-byte sectors). An image is RETAIL only when its size, CRC-32 and SHA-1 match one of these (engine/app/host/disc_identity.h). Rows with game false are other discs (demos): refused by serial. Metadata only: no byte of any disc.
retrieved: 2026-10-25 from http://redump.org/discs/system/ps2/quicksearch/twinsanity/ and http://redump.org/discs/system/ps2/quicksearch/SLPM-65801/; the pages are kept in the stage's evidence (ntsc/redump/disc_*.html)

programs_about: The known retail EXECUTABLES (the program SYSTEM.CNF boots), by their bytes. An image that is no known dump but carries one of these is a MODIFIED disc of that release; one whose program is none of these is 'unknown but plausible'. Which NTSC-U release (1.00 or 2.00) the NTSC-U row is, is not recorded where it comes from; the NTSC-J executable is not known here.
